title: AgentTrail Recipe Marketplace
description: Curated importable recipe packs for auditable local agents. Community submissions should be small, reviewable, and receipt-friendly.

rules: Recipes must have a clear role and concrete task.
File-writing recipes must mention diff preview or explicit Apply.
Security recipes must ask for evidence and avoid unsupported claims.
Packs need at least three useful recipes and one clear target user.
Cloud-only workflows are not accepted for built-in marketplace packs.
